pullback.ema_initialization: SMA of the first 20 closes of each contiguous usable 1h segment

entry.rule: open of the 5m bar whose open_time == open_time[confirmation] + 1 hour

stop.rule: minimum low of the 1h bars from the crossunder bar through the confirmation bar inclusive
stop.invalid_if: stop <= 0 or entry <= 0 or entry <= stop
stop.minimum_stop_note: no separate floor; the 0.20R cost gate implies stop >= 1.30% at 26 bp

clustering.regime_episode: maximal run of consecutive 4h bars with regime_up == true
clustering.primary_view: regime episode containing the 4h bar used at the crossunder
clustering.effective_sample_method: Kish (sum n)^2 / sum n^2 over signal-producing regime episodes, plus cluster count and non-overlap count

episodes.note: one signal maximum per episode by construction

verification.note: causal_regime_lookup is asserted in regime_for_1h: the 4h bar must close at or before the 1h open

control_matched.note: control restricted to the window in which a 4h regime label exists, so the regime contrast is not confounded by a longer control window

overlap.note: control is the shared LTF stream; primary is its regime-eligible subset

effective_sample_size.note: 349 is a planning reference for 0.15R at 80% power under independence; the non-overlapping count is used for the verdict and is not assumed independent.

decision.note: A PASS does not mean profitable. No P&L or expectancy was computed.
